name: millantare
description: Daily rare words and original literature delivered through Telegram.
author: Pasquale Marzaioli

scripts.build: npm run catalog:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run catalog:build && wrangler d1 execute millantare --local --file=data/catalog.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run catalog:build && wrangler d1 execute millantare --remote --file=data/catalog.sql
